verses.transcription: waqaanii hafizun qaahirun jalla maanihu

verses.text: جَمِيعَ الْأَذَى وَخَيْرُ لِى الْيَوْمَ طَآءِعُ
verses.transcription: jamiihal azaa wa khayru lil yawma taa-ihu
ajaaraniyal qahhaaru min jumlatil hidaa
wa khaanat-humu armaahuhum wal madaafihu

verses.text: لَهُ جَلَّ كُلِّى وَهْوَ رَبِّى وَحَافِظِى
verses.transcription: lahu jalla kullii wahwa rabbii wa haafizii
bihi tantafii hannil balaa wal waqaa-ihu
lahu sirtu habdan wal muqafaa wasiilatii
wa as-haabahu usdal ahadi udaarihu

verses.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ يَحْمِينِى وَيَحْمِى جَمِيعَ مَا
verses.transcription: huwal laahu yahmiinii wa yahmii jamiiha maa

verses.text: لِىَ اجْتَارَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعُ
verses.transcription: liyaj taara fid daarayni wal laahu waasihu
yaqiinil azaa fadlan wa yuhtiiniyal munaa
bihi tantafii hannii dawaaman qawaatihu
haliimun hakiimun qad hamaanii bihikmatin

verses.text: وَيَكْفِى جَنَابِى شَرَّ مَا هُوَ وَاقِعُ
verses.transcription: wa yakfii janaabii sharra maa huwa waaqihu
salaatan wa tasliiman minal laahi abtaghii
liman kaana bit tahaati habdan yusaarihu
muhammadinil munjii dawaaman khadiimahu
mahal aali wal as-haabi nihmal mutaawihu

verses.text: كَرِمٌ بِهِ أَرْجُو مِنَ اللَّهِ عِصْمَةً
verses.transcription: karimun bihi arjuu minal laahi hismatan
wa haafiyatad daarayni wal laahu naafihu

verses.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ النَّاسِ أَرْجُو سَعَادَةً
verses.transcription: minal laahi rabbin naasi arjuu sahaadatan
wa an yaqbalal ahmaala wal laahu raafihu
najaatii wa injaa-i wa hawzis tiqaamatan
uhaawiluhaa bil laahi wal qalbu qaanihu
ilal laahi bil qur-aani was sunnatil latii
hadatnii saraftul kulla wal qalbu khaashihu

verses.text: لَهُ صِرْتُ بِالْقُرْءَانِ عَبْدًا خَدِيمَ مَنْ
verses.transcription: lahu sirtu bil qur-aani habdan khadiima man

verses.text: لَهُ خِدْمَتِى شَوْقًا لَّهُ وَهْوَ شَافِعُ
verses.transcription: lahu khidmatii shawqan lahu wahwa shaafihu

verses.text: نَبِىُّ الْهُدَى بَحْرُ النَّدَى ضَيْغَمُ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: nabiyyul hudaa bahrun nadaa dayghamul hidaa

verses.text: مَنِ الْجُودُ يَنْفِى الْفَقْرَ وَالسَّيْفُ قَاطِعُ
verses.transcription: manil juudu yanfil faqra was sayfu qaatihu
ilal mustafaa khayril baraayaa muhammadin

verses.text: صَلَاةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ الَّذِى هُوَ جَامِعُ
verses.transcription: salaatun minal laahil lazii huwa jaamihu

verses.text: سَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمَحِى مَعَ الرُّسْلِ وَالْمَلَآ
verses.transcription: salaamun halal mahii mahar rusli wal malaa

verses.text: مِنَ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ مَنْ هُوَ مَانِعُ
verses.transcription: minal waahidil qahhaari man huwa maanihu
